title: Raw sugar imports threaten local industry, Bukidnon planters warn

blocks.text: QUEZON, BUKIDNON, Philippines — Importing raw sugar to stabilize domestic market prices risks collapsing local production and depressing farm-gate prices nationwide, an industry leader here warned. Pablo Lorenzo III, president and chair emeritus of the Associated Bukidnon Sugarcane Farmers Inc. and Associated Bukidnon Sugarcane Farmers Multi-Purpose Cooperative (ABSFI-ABSMPC), strongly cautioned the government against raw sugar importation, urging it instead to focus on boosting domestic productivity, improving farm efficiency and defending local growers instead of relying on imports. He issued the warning as the ban on sugar importation imposed by the Department of Agriculture is set to end in December. Speaking before […]...
